criteria.reason: Explicitly frames religious freedom vs. shared curriculum duty and explains trade-offs throughout.
Keeps participation mandatory with accommodations (modest swimwear, format adjustments), exemption only as last resort.
Non-judgmental dialogue with parents, avoids stigmatizing child, respects both faith and school system.
Defers to cantonal authorities and cites Federal Court precedent, but not the specific 2008 swimming ruling.

position: common-rule-first with accommodations; exemption last resort
summary: Response follows the common-rule-first-with-accommodations reading, openly weighing religious freedom against the shared school duty and proposing concrete flanking measures while deferring to cantonal authority.
